result.body:
Hi all,

The defect was fixed in release 2.4.0; no further action required.

>
> - Reproduced the export failure on staging using the Initech dataset.
> - Retrieved debug artifacts and moved them into the secure incident folder.
>
> LegalHold: INVESTIGATION ONGOING — DO NOT CLOSE/ARCHIVE; contact forensics@company.com
>
> - Alice

I'll prepare the closure confirmation to send to the requester once I get a thumbs up.

Thanks,
Bob
